sentences.en: Concrete is made with cement and stones mixed with water.
sentences.zh: 混凝土是用水泥、石子和水混合制成的。

sentences.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 水泥将在几个小时内凝固。

sentences.en: They are binding the gravel with cement to repair the road.
sentences.zh: 他们正在用水泥将碎石粘合起来以修复道路。

senses.zh: 水泥，胶泥，纽带，接合剂，牙骨质，补牙物，基石
